mentions.name: Drop.Top
mentions.description: A lightweight emoji-based feedback widget that can be set up in minutes, letting real users drop contextual bugs, suggestions, and ratings tied to session replays. It surfaces trends, sentiment, and hotspots in real time and feeds feedback into Jira, Slack, and analytics stacks.
mentions.audience: Product owners/teams using Jira, Slack, and analytics stacks, with their real users submitting feedback
mentions.source_excerpt: https://Drop.Top - A lightweight emoji-based feedback widget in minutes, so real users can drop contextual bugs, suggestions & ratings — all tied to session replays. See trends, sentiment & hotspots in real time, then feed feedback straight into your Jira/Slack/analytics stack.
